title: How to Use any() in Python
description: Use any() in Python to check whether at least one condition is true, simplify complex conditionals, and see how it compares to the or operator.
summary: As a Python programmer, you’ll frequently deal with Booleans and conditional statements —sometimes very complex ones. In those situations, you may need to rely on tools that can simplify logic and consolidate information.
takeaways: Fortunately, any() in Python is such a tool.
Technical Detail: Python’s any() and or aren’t limited to evaluating Boolean expressions .
Instead, Python performs a truth value test on each argument , evaluating whether the expression is truthy or falsy .
